hypothesis: For novel episode-specific four-key/four-value bindings, genuine official TTT-Linear within-episode adaptation (ttt_base_lr=1.0) reduces held-out query MSE relative to the same parameter-identical trained Mamba-2+attention+TTT architecture with test-time fast-weight update disabled (ttt_base_lr=0.0).
interpretation: This tests a small native hybrid adaptation mechanism, not full language reasoning, novel generalization, autonomous science, or the independent Wingless/Yggdrasil north stars.

arms.architecture: official Mamba2 nonfused -> causal attention -> official TTTLinear -> fixed active depth, train end-to-end
exact same module types, widths, initialization, trainable parameters, AdamW steps and task data; no TTT inner update

training.trainable_scope: full hybrid except deterministic fixed router
training.gradient_budget: 8 identical optimizer updates per arm per seed

episode.format: support [key_i,value_i] for i=0..3 followed by query keys [0,1,2,3,3,2,1,0]. Each episode has fresh independent Rademacher keys and values, marker channels 32:35 discriminate roles; target query value not present at query tokens.
episode.negative_control: cyclically permute only support values within each held-out episode, retain query and target unchanged

primary_metric: Paired per-episode normalized MSE relative improvement = (static_MSE-online_MSE)/static_MSE on held-out query values; positive favors online TTT.
controls: same official upstream pinned SHAs and source blobs
same initial weights per seed and same train/eval episodes
TTT LR=0 conventional static non-adapting control retains identical trainable parameter count and compute graph
shuffled-support negative control; target values never supplied in query inputs
frozen disjoint FIT vs HELDOUT episode seeds; no test data used for optimizer updates
no gradients or updates during heldout evaluation
fresh model per arm to prevent carryover

budget.env: previous R3 frozen Python 3.12 runtime, signed exact .16 headers in temporary CPATH, temp LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/lib/wsl/lib

stop_conditions: missing signed exact Python dev header or hash mismatch
training backward unsupported by native backend
CUDA allocation > 1 GiB or insufficient free memory
any seed/episode or arm budget mismatch
causal future leak or episode carryover
reporting: Do not declare SCIENTIFIC_PASS from a single-run pilot even if thresholds met. Report PRELIMINARY_POSITIVE_REQUIRES_INDEPENDENT_REPLICATION, NULL_OR_NEGATIVE, or ENGINEERING_UNVERIFIED with full negative evidence. No deployment or merge.
